'''Blade Flight''' was a subsection of the [[77th Air Wing]]'s [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] in the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], Blade Flight was led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]], and co-winged by [[Amp]] and [[Ahrens]] by the time of the initial attempt at infiltrating the shaft leading to the [[Citadel of Axes]]' shields' [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]]. Ahrens, however, was killed by an anti-capital ship turret shortly before the failed first attempt. Afterwards, Blade Flight brought in [[Dagger Flight]]'s leader [[Starks]] for the more successful second attempt.
